offering_description.value: Provides investor communications and securities processing technology and outsourcing to broker-dealers, banks, asset managers and corporate issuers. Delivers shareholder communications, trade processing and clearing through software platforms and managed operations.

primary_products.value: investor communications platforms; wealth management software; trade processing software; clearing and settlement software

primary_services.value: proxy and shareholder communications processing; securities processing outsourcing; regulatory document distribution; data analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: broker-dealers, banks, asset managers, mutual funds, corporate issuers

end_markets.value: financial services; capital markets; asset management; corporate governance

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for processing shareholder communications and securities operations; subscription: software platform subscriptions for wealth and investment management clients; transaction or usage fees: per-item and per-transaction fees for trade processing volumes
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: outsourced processing for financial institutions, sold to broker-dealers and asset managers; software / platform: cloud-based software for communications and trade processing, sold to financial firms and issuers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and Asia-Pacific clients

specialization.value: related lines: investor communications, wealth management technology and capital markets technology serving the same financial clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with financial institutions and corporate issuers; online: cloud-based platforms accessed by clients and their investors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC proxy and investor communication rules, broker-dealer regulations and data privacy rules
